text: dsh-auto-review-default 是一款面向 DSH Web 与 Desktop 客户端的会话权限插件。它通过包装权限预设服务的初始权限设置方法，在根会话创建或恢复时切换到内置 Auto review 预设。插件保留委托子会话和定时任务运行会话原有的权限设置，并在 Auto 预设不可用时保持当前预设。适合希望新建及重新打开的根会话自动使用 Auto review 的 DSH 用户；需要启用官方 Auto review 集成。

dsh-auto-review-default switches new and restored root DSH sessions to the built-in Auto review permission preset. It leaves delegated and scheduled-task sessions unchanged and keeps the current preset when Auto is unavailable. The official Auto review integration must be enabled.
想让新建的 DSH 会话默认启用 Auto review 权限预设
重新打开旧会话时也自动切换到 Auto review 怎么设置？
Set newly created and reopened root sessions to use the Auto review permission preset.
dsh-auto-review-default 的功能「根会话采用 Auto review」：根会话创建或恢复时切换到 auto 预设；子代理及定时任务会话跳过。Auto 不可用时保留当前设置。

dsh-auto-review-default README · dsh-auto-review-default：[English](README.en.md) | 中文

把会话放进内置的 `auto` 权限预设（Auto review）：**新建会话在创建时进入**，**已有的根会话在重新打开（恢复）时切过去**。

委托给子代理产生的子会话不会被改动——它们的权限由父会话的委派固定，而且 Auto 的 `ask` 策略会让子会话的审批在委派过程中弹给人。

dsh-auto-review-default README · 它解决什么：DSH 官方有意不让 Auto 成为默认值，两处文档原文：

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets`：「**Auto 不能成为默认值**——它只在 integration effect 存活期间存在，并且有意不进入 `permission` 设置 schema。」
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-permission-presets`：「设置行……`auto` 等仅限当前会话的 contribution 不会出现」「**Auto review 仅限当前会话**」。

结果是通用设置的权限下拉永远只有配置表里的预设，Auto 必须一个一个会话手动切（输入框的权限控件，或 `/permission auto`）。

安装前必须已有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review`（官方随附的实验层）；它在启用状态时本插件才有可切换的目标。

dsh-auto-review-default README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:devil233-ui/dsh-auto-review-default
```

把 `web` 换成你自己的 profile 名（DSH Desktop 用的是 `desktop`）。装完宿主会热加载，不必重启。

dsh-auto-review-default README · 它怎么工作：宿主里唯一决定「会话初始权限」的地方是 `PermissionPresetService#pinInitialPermission(session)`：服务自己的 `session/created` 监听器**对每一个进入 store 的会话**都调它（新建的、恢复的都算），挂载时还会对存量会话各调一次。本插件只包这一个方法：调用原方法之后，若该会话不是委托子会话且当前不在 `auto`，就经官方 `permissionPresets.set` 切到 `auto`。挂在同一个方法上才能在原方法写入任何事件**之前**读到 `session.seq === 0`，从而区分「新建」与「恢复」（只影响日志措辞，采纳与否不依赖它）。

这确实是对宿主内部方法的包装，不是官方扩展点；取舍见下方「已知限制」。

**装载时已经活着的会话故意不动**：插件只在「创建」与「恢复」两个时点动作，所以你正开着的会话会保留它当前的预设，直到它被重新打开。

dsh-auto-review-default README · 安全性质：- **永不抛出**。`session/created` 里的同步异常会否决并回滚会话创建，所以这里任何失败都降级为「保持会话当前预设」，只写一行警告日志。
- **不碰委托子会话**：`dsh-subagent` 会给子会话打 `origin: "subagent"` 与正的 `delegationDepth`（根会话持久化后是 `delegationDepth: 0`，所以只有正数才算子会话）。header 读不出来时一律当作子会话处理，不做猜测。
- **不碰定时任务运行器的会话**：`@michengai/dsh-automation` 的运行会话 id 以 `dsh-automation-session-` 开头，任务创建时自带无人值守预设（通常 `approval: never`），切到 Auto 会把每一步都变成无人应答的授权弹窗（v0.2.0 的实际事故，v0.2.1 修复）。
- **幂等**，并通过 Cordis effect 的 disposer 可逆；在 Auto 不可用（实验层未启用）时自动降级。

dsh-auto-review-default README · 验证记录：在隔离的 `headless` profile 里用一次性任务实测，读会话投影缓存的 `permissions` 值：

| 场景 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 装插件后新建会话 | `preset: "auto"`（sandbox `danger-full-access` + approval `ask`） |
| 不装插件新建会话（基线） | `preset: "workspace-write"` |
| **装插件后恢复那个基线会话** | **`preset: "auto"`**（恢复时切换） |
| 模型起子代理产生的子会话 | 插件未采纳（探针实测 `isChild=true` 被拦下）；子会话上的 `permission/preset auto` 是 `dsh-subagent` 自己把父会话预设拷进去的 |
| `dsh-automation-session-*` 运行会话 | 插件不采纳，保持任务自带的无人值守预设（v0.2.1） |

在 DSH Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2` 上验证。

dsh-auto-review-default README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-auto-review-default
```

dsh-auto-review-default README · 已知限制：- **恢复旧会话时会一律切到 Auto**，包括你曾经显式设成「仅可查看」或「工作区内修改文件」的会话——它会把沙箱放宽到 `danger-full-access`（同时加上逐调用审查）。这是有意的选择，不是副作用；如果你只希望新会话走 Auto，就别装这个插件，或者把 `adopt()` 里的判定收窄。
- **Auto 是实验功能**：可能误放行不安全动作、误拒有用操作，并让每次工具调用多一次模型请求（不缓存、不重试）。本插件只把它设成默认，不改变它的行为。
- **包装的是宿主内部方法名**。DSH 升级若重命名 `pinInitialPermission`，插件会**静默失效**（会话保持各自当前预设），不会报错也不会弄坏启动。升级后若发现新会话不再进 Auto，先查这里。
- 依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` 处于启用状态；它缺失时本插件自动降级。
- 不做按工作区或按 Agent 的细分规则；要那种粒度请用 [`dsh-workspace-tools`](https://github.com/AHIOSUZ/dsh-workspace-tools)（但它目前只允许三个内置预设，不含 `auto`）。

dsh-auto-review-default README · dsh-auto-review-default：English | [中文](README.md)

Puts sessions into the built-in `auto` permission preset (Auto review): **newly created sessions at creation**, and **existing root sessions when they are restored (reopened)**.

Sessions delegated to subagents are never touched — their permission is fixed by the parent's delegation, and Auto's `ask` policy would surface child approvals to the human mid-delegation.
dsh-auto-review-default README · The gap it fills：DSH deliberately keeps Auto out of the new-session default. From the shipped documentation:

dsh-auto-review-default README · The gap it fills：- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets`: "**Auto cannot be the default**: it exists only while its integration effect is alive, and it deliberately does not enter the `permission` settings schema."
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-permission-presets`: "session-only contributions such as `auto` do not appear [in the settings row]" and "**Auto review is current-session only** — the General Settings row deliberately omits it."

dsh-auto-review-default README · The gap it fills：So the General settings permission dropdown only ever lists the configured presets, and Auto has to be selected session by session (the composer's permission control, or `/permission auto`).

The shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` layer must be enabled for this plugin to have a target to switch to.

dsh-auto-review-default README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:devil233-ui/dsh-auto-review-default
```

Replace `web` with your profile name (DSH Desktop uses `desktop`). The host hot-loads new bundles, so no restart is needed.

dsh-auto-review-default README · How it works：The single place that decides a session's initial permission is `PermissionPresetService#pinInitialPermission(session)`: the service calls it from its own `session/created` listener **for every session that enters the store** (freshly created or restored), and once for every session already live at mount time. This plugin wraps that one method: after the original runs, if the session is not a delegated child and is not already on `auto`, it switches to `auto` through the official `permissionPresets.set`. Hooking the same method is also what makes `session.seq === 0` (a genuinely new, empty session) observable *before* the original writes any event — used to distinguish "created" from "restored" for log wording only.

dsh-auto-review-default README · How it works：This does wrap a host-internal method rather than an official extension point; see the limitations below.

**Sessions already live when this plugin mounts are deliberately left alone**: this plugin acts on creation and on restore only, so a session you are working in keeps its preset until it is reopened.

dsh-auto-review-default README · Safety properties：- **Never throws.** A synchronous throw inside `session/created` vetoes and rolls back session publication, so every failure here degrades to keeping whatever preset the session already had — it only writes a warning line.
- **Never touches delegated subagent children**: `dsh-subagent` stamps `origin: "subagent"` and a positive `delegationDepth` (persistence writes `delegationDepth: 0` for root sessions, so only a positive depth means a child). An unreadable header counts as a child: leave it alone rather than guess.
- **Never touches scheduled-task runner sessions**: `@michengai/dsh-automation` names its run sessions with the fixed `dsh-automation-session-` prefix, and a task carries its own unattended preset (typically `approval: never`) — flipping it to Auto would turn every step into an approval prompt nobody may answer (the actual v0.2.0 incident, fixed in v0.2.1).
- **Idempotent**, reversible through the Cordis effect disposer, and degrades automatically when Auto is unavailable.
dsh-auto-review-default README · Verification：Measured in an isolated `headless` profile with one-shot tasks, reading the session projection cache's `permissions` value:

dsh-auto-review-default README · Verification：| Scenario | Result |
|---|---|
| New session with the plugin | `preset: "auto"` (sandbox `danger-full-access` + approval `ask`) |
| New session without it (baseline) | `preset: "workspace-write"` |
| **Reopening that baseline session with the plugin** | **`preset: "auto"`** (switched on restore) |
| A subagent child spawned by the model | not adopted by this plugin (a probe measured `isChild=true` and the guard held); the `permission/preset auto` on the child is written by `dsh-subagent` copying the parent's preset |
| A `dsh-automation-session-*` run session | not adopted; keeps the task's own unattended preset (v0.2.1) |
dsh-auto-review-default README · Verification：Verified on DSH Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`.

dsh-auto-review-default README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-auto-review-default
```

dsh-auto-review-default README · Known limitations：- **Restoring an old session always switches it to Auto**, including sessions you had explicitly set to read-only or workspace-write — it widens the sandbox to `danger-full-access` (while adding per-call review). That is an intended choice, not a side effect; if you only want new sessions to adopt Auto, do not install this plugin, or narrow the `adopt()` check.
- **Auto is experimental**: it can allow unsafe actions, deny useful ones, and it adds one extra model request per supported tool call (no caching, no retries). This plugin only makes it the default; it does not change how Auto behaves.
- **It wraps a host-internal method name.** If DSH renames `pinInitialPermission`, the plugin **silently stops applying** (sessions keep whatever preset they had) — it never errors and never breaks startup. If new sessions stop starting in Auto after an upgrade, look here first.
- Requires the shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` layer to be enabled; the plugin degrades on its own when it is not.
- No per-workspace or per-Agent rules. For that granularity use [`dsh-workspace-tools`](https://github.com/AHIOSUZ/dsh-workspace-tool
